properties.displayName: SCF - Audit logging by category group for microsoft.network/dnsresolverpolicies to Log Analytics
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to ensure security event data from protective controls is collected, aggregated, and stored in a centralized CSP data store, then fed into SCB SIEM for analysis and response. Data includes DDOS metrics, identity risk detection, WAF, DNS, and web access logs from SCF controls: SCF-AUD-01, SCF-AUD-02, IAM-05, SCF-SEC-02, SCF-NETW-04, SCF-NETW-02.
